pages.text: Mages are the backbone of the town. Constructing, crafting, and defending all rely on them.$(br2)Right-click a mage to open the mage panel, where you can set equipment and view inventory (in the top-left of the mage preview).

Follow Mode: When enabled, the mage follows you and ignores town tasks.$(br2)Peaceful Mode: When enabled, the mage will not attack any entity.$(br2)Cast Strategy: Configure spells and casting order, see 《Cast Strategy》.$(br2)Dismiss: Dismiss the mage permanently.
